title: Join eBay Plus Annual Membership & Get a $40 Voucher for Minimum $200 Spend on Eligible Items @ eBay
body:
Deal: Join eBay Plus Annual Membership & Get a $40 Voucher for Minimum $200 Spend on Eligible Items @ eBay

[Brisbane1] This has to be one of the worst deals. They give you only 1 month to use it, minimum spend is $200, can’t stack it with any other coupons, and it doesn’t even work on most items
[JaxSantiago] I find it next to impossible to get something from ebay using their vouchers — the minimum spend kills it for me.
[ozziekhoo] The subscription itself which becomes "free" is also basically useless
[EchoEcho] Just checked my eBay Plus page ( https://www.ebay.com.au/d/ebayplus ) and I only got offered $30 to rejoin, scrolled down further and it has the exact same box but offering $40 😝. T+C says:
| Voucher conditions. The Voucher entitles you to $X off the Seller’s Price (excluding postage costs) on Eligible Items, when you spend $200 or more, with up to 10 items in one transaction during the Validity Period.
[Chickenleg] I got hit with a bunch offers like that and now have all of these vouchers to use but from what i can gather, they're only valid on eBay Plus items, which are becoming less and less. Didn't think eBay Plus could get any worse but here we are. Won't be renewing again.
[davidl222222] I don't even get any "rejoin offers" at all!
they don't offer me, I don't join, it's simple as that!
[uccoffee] how about ask a friend to list an item of 188.03 ?buy it with the voucher for 160
then you get the ebay plus for $11.98 a year, is that a deal ?
[LikezDaBargainz] I got it but it's so bad I deleted it. Oops. eBay has gone to the toilet now.
[Joda] I accepted the ebay membership offer - but didn't get the voucher.
Fairly unpleasant & long experience dealing with ebay support to resolve it.
[Alinnia] In the email right under the Join Now button, it says:
*Eligible users. Issued from 15/12. 1 code pp. Min spend $200. See excls & T&Cs.
So u won't get the voucher until 15th of Dec at the earliest.
[groook] Garbage deal, the voucher will probably apply to like a dozen items, nothing you'd want to buy
[Roobarb] Same here! sold a item for first time in a while >1k, been a ebay plus member for 10 years and had just ran out. They putting a hold on payment for about 2 weeks even though item was delivered without issue.. High value item!
[davidl222222] even worst…I sold an new item and buyer return with an used old broken item + claimed everything including the postage fees on my end!
I lost the item (total lost) + lost postage fees too!
